summary: USBC, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a September 25, 2026 unsecured promissory note with Goldeneye 1995 LLC permitting advances up to $22.0 million. The note bears 8.5% interest payable quarterly from December 31, 2026, matures September 25, 2029, and is prepayable without penalty; default raises the rate to 11.5%. Goldeneye is owned and managed by Chairman/CEO Robert Gregory Kidd, who holds a majority of USBC voting power, making it a related-party transaction. No advances were outstanding at filing; proceeds fund general corporate and working capital. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch related-party governance and liquidity.
